decisions.reason: The existing message 87 MODIFY already records the paperback publication format and PAPERBACK scope for the interior layout; no additional change is required.

The existing message 87 MODIFY already applies the PAPERBACK context to the chapter illustrations; the confirmation does not alter illustration content or placement.
